name: 寶石

pages.text: Gems are a kind of mineral that spawns in a variety of different places, such as $(thing)under rivers$() and in $(l:the_world/geology)Volcanoes$(). For information on the precise conditions, see $(l:the_world/ores_and_minerals)the ores and minerals chapter$().
Gems can be ground into powder using a $(l:crafting/quern)Quern$(). Gem powders are particularly useful in $(l:crafting/glassworking_applications#coloring)Coloring Glass$().

Through $(l:metalworking/sluices)Sluicing$() and $(l:getting_started/panning)Panning$(), $(thing)Uncut Gems$() can be obtained. The gem that can be obtained with the sluice is tied to the rock type of the deposit being processed.
相比於普通的礦石, 寶石礦石有更高的$(thing)硬度$(), 因此需要特定種類的鎬才能挖掘. 挖掘不同種類的寶石礦石所需的$(thing)鎬$()的等級如下:$(br)$(li)紫水晶: 鋼鎬$(li)鑽石: 黑鋼鎬$(li)綠寶石: 鋼鎬$(li)青金石: 鍛鐵鎬$(li)蛋白石: 鍛鐵鎬$(li)黃鐵礦: 銅鎬$(li)紅寶石: 黑鋼鎬$(li)藍寶石: 黑鋼鎬$(li)黃玉: 鋼鎬
To cut a gem, you must craft $(thing)Sandpaper$(). Sandpaper is made from Black Sand, Flux, Glue, any Gem Powder, and Paper. Crafting an uncut gem with sandpaper cuts the gem.
